title: Arbeitnehmer-Pauschbetrag (standard employee allowance)
summary: Employees automatically get a standard allowance of 1,230 EUR for work-related costs (Werbungskosten). Individual costs only reduce tax if the total of all Werbungskosten exceeds this amount.
conditions: Applies to income from employment (§ 9a Satz 1 Nr. 1 a EStG)

sources.label: ELSTER Anleitung 2025, Anlage N, Werbungskosten (Zeilen 32 bis 72)

notes: A planned increase from 2027 is not law and is not encoded.
